claims.author: achow101
claims.harm: Rebroadcasting incoming transactions is useful to help get them confirmed
claims.quote: Rebroadcasting transactions that are not ours is useful as rebroadcasting does have an effect on getting such transactions confirmed.

claims.author: achow101
claims.harm: Incoming transactions must be in the mempool for the wallet to CPFP them
claims.quote: Furthermore, if we want to CPFP a transaction, it needs to be in our mempool first, otherwise the wallet will be unable to broadcast the child.

claims.author: achow101
claims.quote: Instead of trying to delete rebroadcasting in the name of privacy, we should consider other ways to enable rebroadcasting in a privacy preserving manner, such as a rebroadcast pool in the node.
claims.request: Consider enabling rebroadcasting in a privacy-preserving manner, such as a node rebroadcast pool, rather than deleting it

claims.author: instagibbs
claims.quote: I think we need to start a fresh issue on the topic and lay down alternatives side by side
claims.request: Start a fresh issue to lay down and compare rebroadcast alternatives side by side

status_by.quote: I've opened #36403 where we can have more high level discussion about transaction rebroadcast in general.

claims.author: vasild
claims.quote: Concept ACK, but make this configurable somehow.
claims.request: Make the behavior configurable (such as extending -walletbroadcast) so users can decide what fits their priorities
